name: Desktop Companion
title: A small presence at the edge of the screen.
idleLines: I was being quiet. Do not look so suspicious.
I am not pacing. This is a patrol.

responses.move: A positional critique. Fine. I will relocate.
responses.quiet: Quiet, then. I will keep the watch without commentary.
responses.love: I love you too. Obviously. Next question.
responses.help: Drag me, click me, ask about the page, or turn on page sight.
responses.fallback: Filed. I am deciding how much trouble that deserves.
